title: [Hepatocellular carcinoma-derived lactate-mediated histone H3K18 lactylation modifies S100A2 transcription to promote proliferation, migration, invasion and epithelial-mesenchymal transition of hepatocellular carcinoma cells].
authors: Huang, Liping; Shao, Yu; Zhou, Wanbing; He, Jingping
journal: Nan fang yi ke da xue xue bao = Journal of Southern Medical University
one_liner_zh: 该文研究肝癌中乳酸介导的组蛋白H3K18乳酰化调控S100A2转录及下游Wnt通路，虽涉及转录调控和分子对接，但核心是肿瘤表型与信号通路，非TF-DNA结合机制建模，AI/物理模拟方法仅浅层使用。
abstract: OBJECTIVES: To investigate the role of histone H3 lysine 18 lactylation (H3K18la) regulating the transcription of S100 calcium-binding protein A2 (S100A2) in the development of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) and its molecular mechanism. METHODS: HCC single-cell transcriptome sequencing data were used to screen the differentially expressed genes and pathways. Intracellular lactate and histone lactylation were measured in HCC and normal hepatocyte cell lines. The effects of glycolysis inhibitors (2-DG/Oxamate) on proliferation, migration, and invasion of the cells were evaluated, and ChIP-qPCR was used to detect the enrichment of H3K18la at the S100A2 promoter. TCGA database was used to analyze the association of S100A2 expression with the prognosis of HCC patients. S100A2 overexpression and knockdown cell models were established, and rescue experiments using 2-DG or lactate were performed to validate the role of H3K18la in mediating the effects of S100A2. The interaction between S100A2 and KRT6A proteins was validated by STRING, molecular docking, and Co-IP. Western blotting was performed to determine the nuclear expression of beta‑catenin and the EMT markers (vimentin and E‑cadherin) in HCC cells, and to elucidate the regulatory effect of H3K18la on the Wnt/beta‑catenin pathway. RESULTS: Glycolysis and pyruvate metabolism pathways were upregulated in HCC, and lactate levels was elevated in HCC cells. Pan-Kla and H3K18la were significantly overexpressed in HCC cell lines, especially under hypoxia. Glycolysis inhibitors dose-dependently reduced H3K18la and suppressed malignant phenotypes of HCC cells. S100A2 mRNA and protein levels were upregulated in HCC, and its high expression was correlated with poor prognosis. S100A2 promoted HCC cell proliferation, migration, and invasion, which were reversed by 2‑DG. S100A2 directly interacted with KRT6A, the expression of nuclear beta‑catenin was reduced after KRT6A knockdown and increased after KRT6A overexpression; exogenous lactate reversed KRT6A overexpression‑induced inhibition of beta‑catenin, which was blocked by XAV939. Treatment with 2‑DG lowered the expressions of beta‑catenin and EMT markers, which were reversed by S100A2 or KRT6A overexpression. CONCLUSIONS: HCC-derived lactate enhances H3K18la modification, which activates S100A2 transcription to positively regulate the Wnt/beta‑catenin pathway, ultimately promoting the proliferation, migration, invasion and EMT of HCC cells.
abstract_zh: 目的：探讨组蛋白H3赖氨酸18乳酸化（H3K18la）调控S100钙结合蛋白A2（S100A2）转录在肝细胞癌（HCC）发生发展中的作用及其分子机制。方法：利用HCC单细胞转录组测序数据筛选差异表达基因及通路。检测HCC和正常肝细胞系中细胞内乳酸及组蛋白乳酸化水平。评估糖酵解抑制剂（2-DG/Oxamate）对细胞增殖、迁移和侵袭的影响，并使用ChIP-qPCR检测H3K18la在S100A2启动子区的富集情况。利用TCGA数据库分析S100A2表达与HCC患者预后的关联。建立S100A2过表达和敲低细胞模型，并使用2-DG或乳酸进行拯救实验，以验证H3K18la在介导S100A2效应中的作用。通过STRING、分子对接和Co-IP验证S100A2与KRT6A蛋白的相互作用。采用Western blotting检测HCC细胞中β-catenin核表达及EMT标志物（vimentin和E-cadherin），以阐明H3K18la对Wnt/β-catenin通路的调控作用。结果：HCC中糖酵解和丙酮酸代谢通路上调，HCC细胞中乳酸水平升高。Pan-Kla和H3K18la在HCC细胞系中显著过表达，尤其在缺氧条件下。糖酵解抑制剂剂量依赖性地降低H3K18la并抑制HCC细胞的恶性表型。S100A2 mRNA和蛋白水平在HCC中上调，其高表达与不良预后相关。S100A2促进HCC细胞增殖、迁移和侵袭，这些效应可被2-DG逆转。S100A2与KRT6A直接相互作用，KRT6A敲低后核β-catenin表达降低，过表达后升高；外源性乳酸可逆转KRT6A过表达诱导的β-catenin抑制，而XAV939可阻断此效应。2-DG处理降低β-catenin及EMT标志物表达，而S100A2或KRT6A过表达可逆转此效应。结论：HCC来源的乳酸增强H3K18la修饰，激活S100A2转录，进而正向调控Wnt/β-catenin通路，最终促进HCC细胞的增殖、迁移、侵袭及EMT。
